versions.changelog: Reworked demand generation to use real 2011 Census worker counts as spatial weights across Mumbai's 24 lettered BMC administrative wards, aggregated up from 97 real Census fine-ward codes via a crosswalk table (the only non-government source used in this project's ward-level work), replacing the old subdistrict-level average. Fixed the same lat/lon coordinate-order bug found in Kolkata's boundary source. All 97 fine-ward codes and all 24 admin wards matched with zero unmatched codes.

Fixed job totals, which were being calculated from BMC's ward boundaries, covering only about 56% of the map's population. Thane, Navi Mumbai, Kalyan-Dombivli, Mira Bhayandar, and Vasai-Virar were getting zero jobs regardless of total. Now using real 2011 Census worker counts across the full map area. Job total: 5,019,417 -> 8,709,364.

Removed ~312,800 residents incorrectly modeled on top of Mumbai's airports and other aviation infrastructure (up from ~257,800 in the polygon-only pass, now also covering aeroway features mapped as OSM lines), the largest correction of this kind in the batch, and widened the spatial binning resolution for faster in-game loading.
